Junk In The Box

When you rent a dumpster from Junk In The Box, you can be sure that you will receive your dumpster on time and that our team will be with you if have any questions throughout the process. We value all our customer interactions, and view them as an opportunity to build a long-term relationship. We diligently place our dumpsters on wooden planks upon delivery making sure your driveway does not get scratched or damaged. At Junk In The Box, we value our customers and want your return business- there are no delivery fees, pickup fees, or hidden costs associated with delivering a dumpster to you as fast as possible! We have containers that you can rent for any residential or construction clean up you will decide to do. Our bins are the ideal waste containment and removal solution for junk and waste of all types. Below you will find dumpster rentals ranging from 10 – 20 yards. Use our sizing guide below to find the right dumpster for your project and book it at a flat fee via our online reservation system.Schedule a delivery anywhere in Metro Atlanta at anytime.
